tool.name: DtedSelfTest

param.name: keep
param.displayname: Keep the tiles and DTED files in this folder
param.dialogReference: A folder to write the synthetic tiles and the DTED files to and keep them; without it they go to a temporary folder that is removed afterwards.

tool.summary: Converts two built-in synthetic tiles to DTED2, DTED1 and DTED0 from EGM2008 to EGM96 and compares the SHA-256 of every header and record block with the reference pinned in EGMTrans. The tiles are built from integer formulas and hold a lake with a low spot behind a one-post dam, an outlet to a lower lake, ocean, a void block, a flat hilltop and a row on a longitude-spacing boundary, so the resampler, the water rules, the geoid lattice, the rounding and the record writer are all exercised. A match shows that this computer reproduces the reference bytes, so the DTED it makes from real tiles matches any other computer that matches. The same test is available on the command line as "egmtrans dted-selftest".
tool.usage:
• The geoid grids must be present (they are downloaded on the first run of the transform tool).

  • The messages give the versions of EGMTrans, Python, GDAL, numpy and Numba, which two producers compare first when their bytes differ.

  • Run it after installing or updating EGMTrans, and whenever ArcGIS Pro, GDAL or numpy changes.

scriptExample.title: DTED Self-Test
scriptExample.para:
On the command line:

egmtrans dted-selftest

egmtrans dted-selftest --keep C:\temp\selftest
